title: NASA-UAP-D020, Gemini 5 Technical Debriefing, Part II, 1965
doc_notes: This is a declassified NASA Gemini 5 technical debriefing transcript; it contains reports of space debris and frozen waste, but no UAP or extraterrestrial encounters. / This is a technical debriefing transcript for the Gemini 5 mission; it contains one report of an unidentified object sighted during reentry.

encounters.summary: Astronauts observed floating debris, including a washer and a bolt, drifting outside the spacecraft during orbital flight.
encounters.quote: here's that washer floating right in front of my window

encounters.summary: Astronauts observed a large, conical buildup of frozen urine that broke off the spacecraft and drifted away.
encounters.entity_appearance: conical, yellow, approximately 3 inches in diameter and 4 inches high
encounters.quote: It looked like one of those sand castles you build

encounters.summary: Astronauts observed a large object reentering behind their spacecraft during reentry.
encounters.quote: There was some object way behind.
